correctness.rationale: Proof directly derives zeta(t)<0 and zeta prime(t)<0 from the correct fractional-part integral; obtains F(z)<0 for all 0<z<=1/sqrt2 by an explicit absolutely convergent geometric bound; uses only absolutely convergent Dirichlet series for n t>1; controls both endpoint logarithmic singularities and establishes G prime(y)>0 with opposite endpoint limits.
